entries.note: PMID 11527957 abstract: quote verbatim; VEGF TrapA40 systemic, product_in_model false correct. Opens track untested. No change.

Korobelnik CRT quote verbatim; VGT-NC-007/008 confirmed in 125387 PharmR. But DA VINCI (Do 2011, doi 10.1016/j.ophtha.2011.02.018, epub 2011-05-05) already showed CRT fall in DME: earliest public comparison is 2011.

Stewart 2008 (PMID 18356264) conclusion verbatim. Field fix only: the academic decay model was not filed; the rabbit half-life study VGFT-PK-03028 was, so model_filed should be false or noted per decision 8.

2q8 quote verbatim; 42x/56x margin confirmed (125387 SumR 13.2); 2q8 basis VGFT-OD-0508 confirmed. DA VINCI 2q8 arm (Do 2011) tested the 10-12-week prediction first: year 2011. Margin comes from the monkey tox model, not the decay model.

Rodrigues 2018 abstract verbatim; PALM NCT02186119 completed 2015-06 with no results, so untested holds. Field fix: model_filed true, the EMA Rayoqta report section 3.2 describes the rabbit chronic-neovascularisation/VEGF-leak model.

Brown 2024 verbatim; registry 2023-11-21 before epub 2024-03-07, so 2023 holds. magnitude_basis borrows the popPK (15 vs 8.7 weeks); the rabbit's own numbers (leak-free 6 vs 4 weeks, 1.5x) vs 12-16 vs 8 weeks still give within_2x.

Qaum 2001 abstract verbatim; model_filed true confirmed (125387 PharmR VGT-NC-007 intravitreal, VGT-NC-008 systemic, Evans blue 'equivalent to the levels seen in non-diabetic controls'). v2 was wrong, v3 right.

VIVID/VISTA BCVA quote verbatim, primary endpoint, registry dates confirmed. DA VINCI phase 2 primary endpoint (BCVA week 24, +8.6 to +11.4 vs +2.5 laser; Do 2011, PMID 21546089) was public 2011-05: earliest comparison is 2011.

Liu 2022 (PMID 34001667, epub 2021) verbatim; Huang 2012 'less retinal vessel leakage' verbatim; SAILING NCT02194634 status UNKNOWN, no results, registry null correct. Huang 2012 post-dates DA VINCI; see rule question 4.
125387 PharmR Key Study Findings line verbatim modulo OCR (wg for ug). Opens track untested in 2011. Track identity (abicipar package merged in) is rule question 2.

SumR quote verbatim; 42x/56x margin and ENT monitoring confirmed; MONDO:0005150 = AMD confirmed. Decision 5 (#51): a 25-50x margin does not gate same; harm predicted, not seen = contra, magnitude opposite. Drafter used the rejected alternative.
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 5 (#51): erosion at the clinical 2 mg/eye behind a 42–56× margin is a harm prediction the ENT sub-study refuted: contra, opposite. Decision 16 scores the held margin in dose; decision 11 partial fails on the pre-specified nasal readout.

entries.note: EMA/CHMP/279665/2020, adopted 28 May 2020, p.36 verbatim, followed by 'Intraocular inflammation also occurs in human': stated comparison, harm predicted and seen, same + direction_only. CEDAR 2020-07-28 confirmed. On a contra track (decision 6) if entry 2 flips.

761355 PharmR verbatim, 'Per the Applicant' confirmed. Erosions again at 4-7 mg/eye with no NOAEL, ~3x margin, no human signal in PHOTON: same over-prediction, decision 5 contra/opposite; mild IOI matched is the partial route in rule question 3.
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 5 (#51), as index 2: erosions at 4–7 mg/eye, no NOAEL, ~3× margin; PHOTON/PULSAR nasomucosal analysis null: contra, opposite, dated 2023 (first DME dataset). Held margin scores in dose (decision 16); decision 6 keeps the track contra.

entries.note: ClinPharmR lines 942-944 verbatim; Reference ID 5162313 signed 2023-04-21, so 2023 holds. Opens the track untested. If index 6 folds in, carry source_calls_it scaling and PHOTON in patient_trials here.

Lines 289-295 verbatim. PopPK fitted to the BLA's own PHOTON/PULSAR/CANDELA plasma PK; the 15-week ocular figure is unobserved ('treated with caution'). Post-hoc PK/PD justification: untested + source_calls_it scaling, not retro; folds into index 5, dated 2023 like dose 4.
entries.adjudication_note: Dose-cell rule (#50/#118, re-affirmed by decision 16) is the specific rule: a sponsor popPK fitted to PHOTON's own plasma PK, ocular output unobserved, is a post-hoc PK/PD dose justification, untested, source_calls_it scaling, not decision-10 retro; year 2023.

entries.note: Abstract sentence verbatim (full text 403 at ScienceDirect and ASPET); epub 2020-02-25. EMA/415176/2020 s3.2.2 p.27 confirms the in-silico model was filed. Separate system from rabbit-chronic-rnv-leak: built on rabbit IVT PK tissue data (s3.2.2), not the leak model (s3.2.1).

Abstract verbatim. Retrodiction holds: refit to Campochiaro 2013 DME aqueous data (epub 2012-12-04, VEGF neutralised 8-12 weeks). Abstract and EMA state only a PK fit; the VEGF comparison is unverifiable, so magnitude null stands and 'direct' is abstract-based. Campochiaro belongs in patient_trials.

Abstract verbatim. PALM NCT02186119 completed 2015-06, hasResults false, no paper: untested holds. Regimen preceded the model (PALM 2014, CEDAR/SEQUOIA 2015) and EMA calls the simulation dose-selection support: a post-hoc PK/PD justification, so set source_calls_it scaling.

Source: https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/nda/2024/761355Orig1s000ClinPharmR.pdf (bundle sources/761355/761355Orig1s000ClinPharmR.txt lines 289-290).

Abicipar mechanistic translational PK/PD model (rabbit -> human, refitted to nAMD/DME patient aqueous VEGF): Luu 2020, doi 10.1124/jpet.119.263178, PMID 32098861. The draft excluded it as a refit; under decision 10 a refit after patient data is a retrodiction (retro or contra) and is tracked, not dropped.

DA VINCI phase 2 (Do 2011, doi 10.1016/j.ophtha.2011.02.018, PMID 21546089, epub 2011-05-05; 52-week Do 2012, doi 10.1016/j.ophtha.2012.02.010): the first public DME-patient comparison for the rat-leak track (BCVA primary endpoint met, CRT fell) and for the decay-model track (2q8 arm). Not a model, but it redates engagement 2, dose 2 and efficacy 2 to 2011.

Direct-tier engagement in DME patients: aqueous VEGF after intravitreal aflibercept in treatment-naive DME (doi 10.1089/jop.2020.0038, PMID 32589498, 2020) could test the decay model's VEGF-binding prediction in this context; optional, the rat model never measured VEGF.
rule_questions: Decision 5 vs decision 16: a harm the animal showed (monkey nasal turbinate erosion at the clinical per-eye dose) that the regulator placed behind a stated systemic-exposure margin (42-56x, later ~3x) which held. Decision 5 (#51) says the margin does not gate `same` (contra, opposite); decision 16 says a stated margin that held is dose `same` and the harm is counted once. Is the finding scored as dose same only, dose same plus safety contra, or safety same + over_predicted (the decision 5 alternative the drafter used)?

Track identity for toxicology packages: do different members' repeat-dose intravitreal toxicology packages (aflibercept cynomolgus; abicipar rabbit/dog/cynomolgus) form one `model_id` or one per member or species? Under sticky contra (decision 6) merging lets aflibercept's over-prediction colour abicipar's matched prediction; splitting makes the safety headline green on abicipar's track.

Partial safety agreement inside one regulator source (mild transient intraocular inflammation predicted and seen; nasal erosion predicted and not seen): does decision 11 (`same` + `source_calls_it: partial`) or decision 5 (`contra`, opposite) govern a safety entry?

A later class member's model run after the class answer was known in patients (Huang 2012 KH902 in STZ rats, after DA VINCI 2011 showed aflibercept works in DME): is it a prospective prediction for that member (`same`, as drafted) or a class-level retrodiction under decision 10?

Dating under decision 7: a phase 2 trial whose primary endpoint is the same measure as the phase 3 (DA VINCI BCVA at week 24) makes the comparison public three years before VIVID/VISTA. Confirm that a phase 2 primary endpoint counts for an efficacy `same` and sets `year`.

models check: Decision 10 vs the dose-cell post-hoc rule (#50/#118, decision 16): a sponsor popPK fitted to the pivotal trial's own plasma PK whose unobserved ocular-compartment output 'explains' the regimen that held (aflibercept 8 mg, 15 vs 8.7 weeks) - `retro` or `untested` with `source_calls_it: scaling`? The dose rule was applied as the more specific and later-decided one.

models check: Decision 7 dating of an FDA review: its signature/approval year (761355 ClinPharmR signed 2023-04-21, approval 2023-08-18) or its Drugs@FDA posting folder year (nda/2024)? The tile dates dose 4 by approval; the same convention was applied.

models check: Does `retro` require a non-null `magnitude`? Decision 10 rests on reproduction, decision 11 allows the null bin; engagement 4 (Luu 2020) is retro with null because only the abstract and the EMA's PK-fit sentence are readable.

models check: Is a `retro` whose stated reproduction is drug concentration in aqueous humour (PK) admissible in the engagement cell, or does it belong in dose with engagement untested until a measured-VEGF comparison is shown?
